title: Cockroach Crawler: governed web acquisition for AI agents (0.7 release-candidate source snapshot)
description: Source snapshot for the Cockroach Crawler 0.7 release candidate pinned to commit 90825063d447f07345388d040b1428a311109c2b. The candidate separates bounded Node crawling, provider routing, browser-host integration, opt-in quality extraction, and a restricted serverless profile. Frozen raw-DOM attempt 003 was rejected and authorizes no 0.7 release, ranking, best-crawler statement, or universal 0.90 claim. The current published npm baseline remains 0.6.1.
notes: Release-candidate metadata only. Do not publish as a stable 0.7 software release unless a later frozen candidate passes every declared gate and the reviewed package, tag, provenance, website, and archival files agree.
